entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Kestrel HTTPS throughput on linux-arm64 about 20 % lower with .NET 11.0.0 than with 10.0.15 (daily-build bisect points to #131177) #137385

    11.0.0

  • [RISC-V] Zacas support for Interlocked.CompareExchange #137345
  • PersistedAssemblyBuilder writes an enclosing exception clause before the clauses nested in its handler, so the JIT rejects the method (InvalidProgramException) #137342

  • NET11: ECDsa.Create doesn't throw on linux if parameters are wrong #137336
    12.0.0
  • Some MemoryMarshal methods are source incompatible in .NET11 #137334
  • JIT: unrolled loop re-dispatches its switch with the index folded to 0 (not backported to .NET 11) #137330
    11.0.0
  • Monitor.Wait can throw ThreadInterruptedException without reacquiring the lock #137329
  • BigInteger left shift no longer enforces the maximum length in .NET 11 #137327
  • KillOnParentExit rejects the Microsoft Store PowerShell execution alias with access denied #137325

  • [aw] Detection Runs #137314
